title: ITI-YY5 manifest request
description: Restates IHE VHL ITI-YY5, 2:3.YY5.4.1.2 Message Semantics; Stakeholder directive: Verifiable Health Links follow IHE VHL, CBOR map at key 5. IHE VHL ITI-YY5 Retrieve Manifest, 2:3.YY5.4.1.2 Message Semantics: “The VHL Receiver performs an HTTP POST to the _search endpoint with the manifest URL parameters from the VHL payload”. Stakeholder directive: Verifiable Health Links follow IHE VHL, CBOR map at key 5: “Manifest -> go with IHE VHL”.

statements.label: ITI-YY5 manifest request
statements.requirement: The library SHALL build the ITI-YY5 Retrieve Manifest request from a VHL payload: POST to <base>/List/_search (accepting a manifest URL of either the List?... or the List/_search?... form), Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded, body holding the manifest URL's search parameters (_id, code, status and patient.identifier required; _include=List:item optional) plus recipient (required), passcode (required when, and only when, the payload's flag has P) and embeddedLengthMax (optional). It SHALL refuse a payload whose URL lacks a required parameter. Sending the request is the host's.
